title: Carasent AB (publ): Revised 2025 targets and new medium-term financial targets
content:
Carasent announced revised 2025 financial guidance and established new medium-term targets ahead of their Q2 2025 results release.

H1 2025 Performance Update:
- H1 revenues of SEK 168 million
- EBITDA of SEK 26 million
- EBITDAC of SEK 7 million
- Approximately SEK 5 million in extra costs, described as mostly non-recurring
- Expenses stemmed from organizational restructuring within Ad Opus and an implementation project with Volvat

Revised 2025 Targets:
- Revenue: SEK 345-350 million (previously SEK 350 million)
- EBITDA: SEK 75 million (previously SEK 82-87 million)
- EBITDAC: SEK 35 million (previously SEK 44-49 million)

New Medium-Term Targets (2026-2028):
- Organic revenue growth: 15% average annual growth
- EBITDA margin: 35% by 2028
- Capital expenditure: Mid to high single-digit percentage of revenue

CEO Daniel Öhman stated: 'We have experienced some headwinds during 2025' yet emphasized the long-term potential remains intact, supported by new sales wins and existing revenue backlog.
